games.name: Tidy Up The Chocolate Factory
games.description: Tidy up a magical chocolate factory solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. Sort hundreds of sweet varieties, unlock helpful upgrades, and complete collections to bring candy gardens into bloom. Chocolate streams, marshmallow flowers, and a delicious mess await!

games.name: RIP-OFF
games.description: Buy booster packs from Panda, a shady raccoon dealer, and slice them open with one swipe of a knife. Collect, stack, sell and archive 280 pixel-art cards across four series, then upgrade your table until the packs open themselves.

games.name: Crack a Pack
games.description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

games.name: World on a Plate
games.description: Cook your way around Europe in this cozy co-op kitchen adventure for one to two players. Prepare authentic regional dishes, keep your kitchen running smoothly, and manage busy restaurants across diverse European cultures and cuisines, while uncovering Grandma’s story behind her legendary restaurant.

games.name: MicroMayhem
games.description: The party game that doesn't give you time to think: 100+ five-second micro-games, faster and faster. 4 players on one screen, up to 8 online, or solo, with RICO and ZIP calling it live. Remote Play Together: only one copy needed!

games.name: Hatchbar
games.description: Hatch eggs in a thin strip above your taskbar while you work. Fuse any two Hatchlings into a new species, then hand them to your adventurers as weapons. An idle RPG with 47 creatures to discover. Never steals focus, clicks pass through. One price, no ads. Free demo out now.

games.name: The Idle Captain
games.description: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.

games.name: Fantasy Boy
games.description: Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

games.name: SUPERPANEL
games.description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

games.name: FUCHI's Chick: Mini Many PANIC
games.description: Up to 4 players hatch baby chicks and lead them to the shipping yard! A cute, chaotic party game starring the deadpan chicks of FUCHI, the illustrator behind the hugely popular LINE stickers. Lead a wobbly parade, dodge thieves and enemies, and dress up in collected outfits. Play locally or online.

games.name: 돌깨
games.description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

games.name: PixelHeroLegend
games.description: Build a team of heroes in this pixel-art idle RPG. Collect equipment, adjust tactics, explore regions, and take on enemies in automatic battles.

games.name: Sam Buku Per
games.description: hardcore piloting simulator with romantic elements. You will have to balance between the laws of physics and the laws of gravity. Every extra maneuver burns fuel, which separates you from the base... and from a kiss.

games.name: Neverwake
games.description: You won't survive your first adventure. Probably not your second, either. Explore a retro pixel art fantasy world, fight monsters in turn-based battles, collect loot, and unlock permanent RPG upgrades. Die, learn, grow stronger, and push further with every new run.

games.name: Bottled Gleams
games.description: A cozy incremental idle game for your desktop. In the Cat Squeeze bottle, scoop up and pet a cat hunting for dried fish. In the Deck of Harvest bottle, moles mine and ship their haul for coins. Tap keys or click to boost output. Spend idle earnings on capsules for skins, weather and décor.

games.name: Potion Pantry: Sort the Apothecary
games.description: A cozy sorting game set in an old candlelit apothecary. Thousands of potions, each with its own name and label, and liquid that sloshes as you carry it. Ride the rolling ladders, fill crates, and put every shelf back the way it was, to rekindle the light of your late mother's spirit.

games.name: KER
games.description: KER is a 2D puzzle strategy heist game where you play as Agent Orange, who have to enter into most secure building and get the FILE securely. The building is equipped with pass cords and other securities measure, but only aim to get out the file securely.

games.name: The Last Duck
games.description: The Last Duck is a top-down roguelite shooter where you play as a rebellious duck battling hordes of farm animals. Wield up to 6 weapons, collect powerful items, create unique builds, and fight your way through the farm and into the wild!

games.name: Will It Break?
games.description: Pack a bottle, yeet it down the stairs, and posterize the outtake. A clean delivery pays but a spectacular disaster might pay better. Build a channel from just you and your mom and besties built on physics chaos, one staircase at a time.

games.name: Rocco’s Card Shop
games.description: Rip open packs, pull Golden cards and turn Rocco's tiny card shop into an empire. Flip cards on a live market, grade your best, run the auction house, dodge the loan shark, then close up shop and come back bigger. One more pack. Just one more.

games.name: Idle Fish: Aquarium Legends
games.description: Build your own pixel aquarium! Open chests, collect rare fish, feed them to grow, and combine three into a higher rarity. Sell fish for pearls, decorate your tank, and assemble a team of three for automatic battles. Your next legendary discovery awaits.

games.name: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler
games.description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

games.name: One Twisted Boxing Day
games.description: Build a manic gift-making factory as you buy upgrades, race the clock, chase quotas, fight off inspectors, and gently... unalive your employees in this comedic Christmas-themed real-time automation game. For the good of the company!

games.name: Fishlings: A Cozy Fish Collector
games.description: A cozy idle aquarium where every fish comes out of a card pack. Rip packs, flip cards, chase the 1-in-1,000 Prismatic and collect 80+ odd little fish in four variants. Your tank keeps growing and earning while you're away, or swims in a tiny window on your desktop while you work.

games.name: Frog Express
games.description: Collect frogs and upgrade your express in an active incremental game! Power up manual collection, install automated modules, or combine both. Merge hats, fill your frog album, and unlock permanent upgrades to travel further with every run.

games.name: Garden Cleaner: Cozy Grass Simulator
games.description: 200,000+ blades of grass. Two bare hands. Pull them one by one, sell the harvest, and work your way up to a riding mower in a calm, cozy first-person yard cleaning game.

games.name: Between the Days
games.description: Between the Days is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game inspired by everyday life in Japan. Sort objects, discover patterns, and solve little puzzles through simple clicks and drags. Take a relaxing journey through Tokyo's four seasons, even if you've never visited Japan.

games.name: Redneck Redemption
games.description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

games.name: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging
games.description: A wheelchair ski jumping roguelite about chasing victory in the Happy Friendship Cup. You time your jump at the edge of the ramp and hope your body holds out until the last hill.

games.name: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings
games.description: A Short Hike meets a late-night Adult Swim show. A witch just set her cat on fire, and now she wants Sylvia Sparrow to hunt down her lost paintings. Adventure across Witch Isle and meet mean, creepy, ugly and brutally honest characters who’ll help you find every last one.

games.name: Brokie
games.description: You went all in with borrowed money and lost everything. Start over with $3,000 in a share house: work part-time jobs, gather clues from news, rumors and store shelves, trade 18 fictional stocks and keep your stress in check. How far can you climb in one year?

games.name: Eldritch Survivors
games.description: Eldritch Survivors is a Lovecraftian roguelite where you kill swarms of enemies, gain insight to the Mythos, and unlock otherworldly powers. Can you survive long enough to stop The Cosmic Conspiracy’s nefarious plans?

games.name: Short Circuit
games.description: It never stops raining in this abandoned world. Use your disc to turn the machines back on and find out what happened. A minimalist puzzle-platformer made with PICO-8.

games.name: Whenster
games.description: Who knows when what happened? Whenster is a timeline card game for friends: place movies, TV series, video games, inventions and historic events in the right order before the clock runs out. Host on Steam, and your friends join for free right in their browser.

games.name: Trivia Arena: The Grand Stage
games.description: A party trivia game show on a grand velvet stage. Up to 8 friends join with their phones as controllers: no app, just scan the QR code. Answer wrong and your plush drops through a trapdoor. Three game modes, thousands of questions, seasonal events and online play with friends.

games.name: Dark Kitchen
games.description: Dark Kitchen is a 2–4 player co-op game, playable online or in split-screen. Survive the kitchen rush while your friends race across town to deliver orders on time, and guard your food from rivals who'll stop at nothing to steal it!

games.name: Counter Ducks
games.description: An asymmetric FPP/TPP shooter with two different game modes. In PvE, hunt ducks solo or in co-op, earn money, and upgrade your gear. In PvP, switch roles and play as a duck against hunters in chaotic 4v4 battles!

games.name: Deepfold: One Day Deep
games.description: Deepfold is a papercraft mining story about letters from your grandmother, trapped 66 million years in the past since a 2019 accident. She lived there 20 years. Plant ore in the past, fast-forward millions of years, and dig it up by hand. Each upgrade brings up her next letter. Take your time.

games.name: Santa's Sweatshop
games.description: A first-person incremental game set in Santa's warehouse. Wrap gifts, load the conveyor belt and meet a daily quota that grows every day. Earn cookies to buy upgrades, expand the warehouse and hire elves to help you.

games.name: PixelOffice
games.description: A tiny pixel office sits in a corner of your desktop and keeps you company while you work. Start the focus timer and its coworkers get to work; take a break and they wander off to the lounge for pool and small talk. Level up to grow the team, dress them up, and yes, you can pet the dog.

games.name: Last Backup: A Digital Legacy Story
games.description: Unlock laptops, sort messy desktops and return memories to families. Run a cozy digital legacy office, solve clue-based passwords through 100 cases, and uncover your grandfather's mystery. Every folder brings you closer to the person behind the screen.

games.name: Last Card
games.description: A card roguelike played across the table from a masked dealer. Chain cards by color, number or symbol to stack chips and multipliers and beat the night's target. Miss it and a candle goes out. When the last one goes out, the house wins.

games.name: PACKFISH
games.description: Packfish is a cozy pack-opening incremental game about collecting fish. Tear open packs, flip the cards and chase shiny Golden and Prism editions. Build living aquariums that earn while you're away, breed secret hybrids and complete a collection of 97 species. Just one more pack...

games.name: RIP ME!
games.description: RIP ME! is a pixel-art booster pack incremental. Rip packs, pull shiny hits, clean and grade your best cards, then show them off in your display case. Build a Rip Bot, chase God Packs and misprints across an ever-growing lineup of series, and hunt the legendary Grails.

games.name: Crack & Stack
games.description: Race up to six friends to stack dice and crack puzzles in this chaotic party game! Based on the 2025 board game, Crack & Stack, you can now play online, split-screen, or solo against the commentary team, and turn on Chaos Mode for rounds that bend all the rules!

games.name: Sort Cats Together
games.description: A toy store full of cats needs sorting! Play solo or team up with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op game. Find 200 different cat designs, sort 4,000 toys onto their matching shelves, and unlock upgrades to turn a mountain of cats into a tidy collection.

games.name: Sovia: Five Year Plan
games.description: A cozy competitive card game in Sovia's broadcast station. Race to complete five plans, hand your building resources to rivals, scout their cards, and survive disasters. Six seats by default, with computer players and friend rooms.

games.name: Semaphore
games.description: A train simulator with systemic horror. You are the driver and the conductor of a night train in the People's Republic of Ordovia. Drive the train, meet the passengers, check their papers and look after them. Solve the mysteries of Ordovia's railways and fulfil the state's plan.

games.name: Sovia: Box & Order
games.description: Run a busy little paper warehouse. Shelve chilled, fragile and bulky goods, pack the right boxes, rest a tired crew and chain their skills into an ensemble. Follow eight stops to recover a lost route book, then reshape any warehouse in the level editor.

games.name: Dead Or Drawn
games.description: A Wild West party game of drawing, describing and bluffing for 3–6 players. The narrator secretly sees a suspect and describes it out loud while everyone sketches it on a WANTED poster. The posters go up on the board, anonymous. Can you spot the narrator's drawing?

games.name: Shadows of Hollow Creek
games.description: Uncover the truth. Survive the night. Hollow Creek is a narrative-driven psychological thriller game where investigative journalism leads Clara Pierce to an isolated town plagued by disappearances, buried secrets, and whispers of a witch. Some stories are better left untold.

games.name: Limited-time Game Bundle Challenge
games.description: A bunch of Normal Retro Classic games, but what if, you need to change to another game when the Count Down ends. How many Score can you get?

games.name: INTERNET4
games.description: INTERNET4 lets up to 8 people control one browser together and turn the internet into a shared playground. Watch videos and livestreams, split the browser to explore the web, or draw together. Enjoy Wikipedia-based minigames or unwind with some fishing.

games.name: Death Draft
games.description: A team FPS where every round adds a new bad idea. Draft cards that give enemies huge heads, turn you into a giant or bend the fight in your favor. Everyone gets the same weapons. The cards are up to you. Play with friends or bots in matches up to 5v5.

games.name: Silentes: Cursed Children
games.description: Explore Brazilian cities threatened by supernatural roots in this top-down 2D RPG. Investigate the source of the calamity alongside three heroes with special abilities tied to Brazilian folklore.

games.name: Rig'n'Roll: GOLD
games.description: Hit the highways of California in the most complete edition of the classic truck-driving simulator! Build your trucking empire, compete with rival drivers, explore an expanded world, and enjoy the complete Monster Cup expansion, additional trucks, and over 140 side missions.

games.name: BONKABIND
games.description: Ever forgotten how to shoot in the middle of a gunfight? In BONKABIND, players can swap each other's keyboard and mouse controls! One round you're a sharpshooter. The next, you're running backward, crouching by accident, and wondering where your shoot button went.

games.name: Puppetria
games.description: A slightly unusual tea party in an old mansion. As you serve tea and sweets, teapots begin to dance and little ghosts appear... Your job is to quietly smooth over the mansion's lively welcome. Keep an eye on each new surprise and make sure the tea party stays elegant until the very end.

games.name: Cat Stack
games.description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

games.name: Earthworks
games.description: Build your own earthmoving company! Buy trucks and excavators, compete for contracts, hire employees, manage your fleet, and grow your business. Overcome economic challenges, expand your operations, and build your construction empire in this 2D management simulation.
